question:
A company has three types of products, I, II, and III. The contract orders for each quarter of the next year are shown in Table 1-23. At the beginning of the first quarter, there is no inventory, and it is required to have 150 units of each product in inventory at the end of the fourth quarter. It is known that the company has 15,000 hours of production time per quarter, and it takes 2 hours, 4 hours, and 3 hours to produce one unit of products I, II, and III, respectively. Due to the replacement of production equipment, product I cannot be produced in the second quarter. It is specified that if the products cannot be delivered on time, a compensation of $20 per unit per quarter is required for products I and II, and $10 for product III. If the produced products are not delivered in the same quarter, a storage fee of $5 per unit per quarter is incurred. How should the company arrange production to minimize the total compensation and storage fee?

Table 1-23
\begin{tabular}{c|c|c|c|c}
\hline \multirow{2}{*}{Product} & \multicolumn{4}{|c}{Contract Orders for Each Quarter} \\
\cline { 2 - 5 } & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\
\hline I & 1500 & 1000 & 2000 & 1200 \\
II & 1500 & 1500 & 1200 & 1500 \\
III & 1000 & 2000 & 1500 & 2500 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "products": ["I", "II", "III"],
    "quarters": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    "orders": {
        "I":   {1: 1500, 2: 1000, 3: 2000, 4: 1200},
        "II":  {1: 1500, 2: 1500, 3: 1200, 4: 1500},
        "III": {1: 1000, 2: 2000, 3: 1500, 4: 2500},
    },
    "labour_h": {"I": 2, "II": 4, "III": 3},
    "capacity_h": 15000,
    "storage_cost": 5,
    "compensation": {"I": 20, "II": 20, "III": 10},
    "initial_inventory": 0,
    "final_inventory_required": 150,
    "blocked": {"I": [2]},
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    products = list(d["products"])
    quarters = list(d["quarters"])

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=products)
    model.Q = pyo.Set(initialize=quarters)

    order = {(p, q): d["orders"][p][q] for p in products for q in quarters}
    labour = d["labour_h"]
    cpac = d["capacity_h"]
    hcost = d["storage_cost"]
    comp = d["compensation"]
    init = d["initial_inventory"]
    fin = d["final_inventory_required"]
    blocked = d["blocked"]

    ub_produce = {(p, q): 0 if q in blocked.get(p, []) else cpac // labour[p]
                  for p in products for q in quarters}

    model.produce = pyo.Var(
        model.P, model.Q,
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers,
        bounds=lambda m, p, q: (0, ub_produce[(p, q)])
    )

    model.store = pyo.Var(model.P, model.Q, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # shortfall units not met by the time they were due in quarter q (lagged costs)
    model.short = pyo.Var(
        model.P, model.Q,
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers,
        bounds=lambda m, p, q: (0, order[(p, q)] + fin)
    )

    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(comp[p] * m.short[p, q] for p in m.P for q in m.Q) + \
               sum(hcost * m.store[p, q] for p in m.P for q in m.Q)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    def cap_rule(m, q):
        return sum(labour[p] * m.produce[p, q] for p in m.P) <= cpac
    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.Q, rule=cap_rule)

    def block_rule(m, p, q):
        if q in blocked.get(p, []):
            return m.produce[p, q] == 0
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip
    model.block = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.Q, rule=block_rule)

    def balance_rule(m, p, q):
        prev_store = init if q == quarters[0] else m.store[p, q - 1]
        return prev_store + m.produce[p, q] - m.store[p, q] + m.short[p, q] == order[(p, q)]
    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.Q, rule=balance_rule)

    def final_rule(m, p):
        return m.store[p, quarters[-1]] >= fin
    model.final_inv = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=final_rule)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "products": [1, 2, 3],               # I, II, III
    "periods": [1, 2, 3, 4],             # quarters
    "order": {                            # contract orders order[p][t]
        1: {1: 1500, 2: 1000, 3: 2000, 4: 1200},
        2: {1: 1500, 2: 1500, 3: 1200, 4: 1500},
        3: {1: 1000, 2: 2000, 3: 1500, 4: 2500},
    },
    "hours": {1: 2, 2: 4, 3: 3},         # production hours per unit
    "capacity": 15000,                   # hours available per quarter
    "penalty": {1: 20, 2: 20, 3: 10},    # compensation per unit per quarter
    "holding": 5,                        # storage fee per unit per quarter
    "init_inventory": 0,
    "final_inventory": 150,
    "no_produce": [(1, 2)],              # product I cannot be produced in quarter 2
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"], ordered=True)
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["periods"], ordered=True)

    # x[p,t]: production; short[p,t]: undelivered units; inv[p,t]: ending inventory
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.short = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.inv = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: minimize compensation + storage cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        comp = sum(d["penalty"][p] * m.short[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        hold = sum(d["holding"] * m.inv[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        return comp + hold
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    t_list = d["periods"]

    # Inventory balance: prev_inv + x - end_inv = order - short
    def balance_rule(m, p, t):
        prev = m.inv[p, t - 1] if t > t_list[0] else d["init_inventory"]
        return prev + m.x[p, t] - m.inv[p, t] == d["order"][p][t] - m.short[p, t]
    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # Final quarter ending inventory requirement
    def final_rule(m, p):
        return m.inv[p, t_list[-1]] == d["final_inventory"]
    model.final_inv = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=final_rule)

    # Product I cannot be produced in quarter 2
    model.no_produce_pairs = pyo.Set(initialize=d["no_produce"], dimen=2)

    def no_produce_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] == 0
    model.no_produce = pyo.Constraint(model.no_produce_pairs, rule=no_produce_rule)

    # Capacity: total production hours per quarter <= capacity
    def cap_rule(m, t):
        return sum(d["hours"][p] * m.x[p, t] for p in m.P) <= d["capacity"]
    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cap_rule)

    return model

    # End-of-quarter inventory (leftover, undelivered) of product p

    # End-of-quarter backlog (undelivered contract units) of product p
    model.back = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

        stor = sum(d["storage"] * m.inv[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        return comp + stor

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # --- Constraints ---

    # Inventory/backlog balance for each product and quarter
    def balance_rule(m, p, t):
        prev_inv = d["init_inventory"] if t == d["quarters"][0] else m.inv[p, t - 1]
        prev_back = d["init_backlog"] if t == d["quarters"][0] else m.back[p, t - 1]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # Production time capacity per quarter
    def cap_rule(m, t):
        return sum(d["hours"][p] * m.x[p, t] for p in m.P) <= d["capacity"]

    # storage holding cost per unit per quarter
    "storage_cost": 5.0,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    prod_list = d["products"]
    period_list = d["periods"]

    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Sets
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    m.P = pyo.Set(initialize=prod_list)
    m.T = pyo.Set(initialize=period_list)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Variables
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    m.prod = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    m.inv = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    m.pen = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Objective: minimize storage fees + compensation penalties
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def obj_rule(m):
        storage = sum(
            d["storage_cost"] * m.inv[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T
        )
        compensation = sum(
            d["penalty_cost"][p] * m.pen[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T
        )
        return storage + compensation

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint: inventory balance each quarter
    #   prev_inv + prod + current_new_backlog = demand + inv + carried_backlog(prev backlog)
    #   Specifically: inv_{t-1} + prod_t + pen_t = demand_t + inv_t + pen_{t-1}
    #   with inv_{-1}, pen_{-1} given (initial values).
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def balance_rule(m, p, t):
        if t == 0:
            inv_prev = d["initial_inventory"]
            pen_prev = d["initial_inventory"]
        else:
            inv_prev = m.inv[p, t - 1]
            pen_prev = m.pen[p, t - 1]
        return (
            inv_prev
            + m.prod[p, t]
            + m.pen[p, t]
            == d["demand"][p][t] + m.inv[p, t] + pen_prev
        )

    m.balance = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint: mandatory last-quarter inventory
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def final_inv_rule(m, p):
        last_t = period_list[-1]
        return m.inv[p, last_t] >= d["final_inventory"]

    m.final_inv = pyo.Constraint(m.P, rule=final_inv_rule)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint: production time capacity per quarter
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def time_cap_rule(m, t):
        return (
            sum(d["prod_hours"][p] * m.prod[p, t] for p in m.P)

        return holding + comp

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)
